_comment: Cross-language physics conformance vectors. Read by BOTH backend/tests/test_hassault_physics.py and packages/core/src/modules/hassault/__tests__/conformance.test.ts. These pin that the two implementations agree, not that either is correct in the abstract - correctness is what each side's own unit tests are for. Regenerate only when a rule genuinely changes, and make both suites pass before committing.

cases.name: walks east across a flat room
slides north along the east wall
jump arc returns to the floor
is refused by a four-unit ledge
walks up the same ramp the other way
falls onto the floor under gravity
a huge dt is clamped, not integrated
cannot move sideways in a two-cell corridor

spawns.name: a spawn floating above flat ground stands on the ground
a spawn buried below the floor is lifted onto it
entity z does not change the height at all
a spawn over the raised half stands on the raised half
a spawn over the four-unit ledge stands on the ledge
a body straddling a step is placed on the higher floor
a spawn on a heightfield takes the corner-averaged floor
entity yaw is degrees clockwise, converted to radians
